ir.name: loss_pairwise_softmax_relaxed_preference_gap_weighted_mae
ir.intuition: This loss uses softmax relaxed preference probabilities but penalizes with absolute difference (MAE) instead of log probability, blending preference modeling with a robust absolute error metric, weighted by absolute advantage gap and sample weight for stable optimization.
ir.pseudocode:
lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
weight = batch.get('weight', ones_like(lpw))
margin = lpw - lpl
prob_w = exp(margin) / (exp(margin) + 1)  # sigmoid from softmax formulation
abs_error = abs(prob_w - 1.0)  # absolute error penalizing deviation from perfect preference
loss_vec = abs(adv_gap) * abs_error * weight
final_loss = mean(loss_vec)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    exp_margin = ops.exp(margin)
    denom = ops.add(exp_margin, ops.ones_like(exp_margin))
    prob_w = ops.div(exp_margin, denom)
    abs_error = ops.abs(ops.sub(prob_w, ops.ones_like(prob_w)))
    loss = ops.mul(ops.abs(adv_gap), abs_error)
    loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss)
